_comment: Scale-corpus distribution config. Weights are relative (need not sum to 1). Skewed so a few hot flows dominate with a long tail. Cohort mix follows the `cohorts` weights below. replayOnFraction is overridden per run via --replay-on-fraction (initial run = 1.0; later ~0.15).
_variantWeights: k=1..8, skewed: two hot variants, long tail
_anchorFraction: share of sessions that drive the existing anchor flows (keeps the pay/customer/appointment canonical journeys present at scale)
_userPopulation: distinct_id cardinality: ~600 single / ~90 repeat(2-4) / ~10 power(~13) per 1,000
_needles: ~5 designated rare flows, 1-3 sessions each, always completed; one carries the planted exception (the needle check)
_dwell: Normal sessions dwell 150-400ms after navigating clicks; fast-slice 0-30ms deliberately produces capture loss. preCloseMs + flushMs before context close; replayFlushMs longer for rrweb-on sessions. flushMs raised 2200->5000 because context.close() fires no pagehide, so the final queued events raced the close and dropped; now matches replayFlushMs and pairs with the about:blank pre-close pagehide flush (drive-helpers.mjs preCloseFlush). Fast-slice dwells are untouched — deliberately lossy.
_pacing: ≤4 session-starts/s; batches ≤500 with a ≥3min inter-batch gap (rate-limit courtesy; read back landed counts in the gap).
